tools.description: Reject a queued category suggestion with optional source and note metadata.

dryRun.description: Validate and preview rejection without writing

tools.name: resolve-placeholder-transaction
tools.description: Resolve an unresolved placeholder by updating the original transaction with final known details while preserving placeholder audit metadata.

tools.name: restore-database
tools.description: Preview a Shikin SQLite restore by default. Pass apply:true to restore after validation and create a rollback backup.

file.description: Path to a Shikin SQLite backup file to restore

dryRun.description: Legacy preview flag. Explicit false still applies for one compatibility cycle.

tools.name: reverse-bucket-allocation
tools.description: Append an equal negative reversal for a positive cashflow allocation. Original rows are preserved. Does not change real account balances or transactions.

dryRun.description: Validate and preview without writing

tools.name: review-suggestions
tools.description: List queued category suggestions for review.

tools.name: revise-classification-type
tools.description: Append an immutable named-type revision after checking the expected current head. Existing assignments remain pinned.

tools.name: save-spending-recap
tools.description: Explicitly save a spending recap. Writes only recaps and audit_log; identity includes type, period, all-currencies scope and selected basis. Unchanged re-saves are no-ops.

type.description: Type of recap: weekly (past 7 days) or monthly (full month)

period.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to target a specific month.

tools.name: set-account-alias
tools.description: Assign a friendly alias to an existing account so future commands can use --account instead of a long account ID.

dryRun.description: Validate and preview the alias without writing it

tools.name: set-exchange-rate
tools.description: Append an effective-dated direct manual rate or immutable correction. Backdating and corrections require an audit note and explicit historical-change acknowledgement.

rateDecimal.description: Positive plain decimal; never exponent notation

effectiveFrom.description: Calendar date when this direct rate starts applying

replacesRateId.description: Current leaf rate ID to correct immutably

auditNote.description: Required reason for a correction or backdated rate

tools.name: set-main-currency
tools.description: Explicitly save the database-backed main reporting currency. This never relabels accounts, transactions, plans, snapshots, or other records.

tools.name: set-source-coverage
tools.description: Create or explicitly revise independent printed-period source evidence, including zero-row periods and gaps. Does not finalize transactions.

account.description: Account alias, ID or name

sourceNamespace.description: Case-sensitive import source namespace (not audit source)

anyOf.description: Independent statement/document evidence; no fake transactions

documentRef.description: Independent statement/document evidence; no fake transactions

tools.name: set-transaction-consumption
tools.description: Set an explicit allocation-level consumption classification. Choose one builtin role or one active custom type/current revision. Refund/principal treatments require a same-currency purchase classification; each treatment has an independent aggregate cap.

tools.name: settle-staged-transactions
tools.description: Deliberately settle exact pending ordinary staged rows to posted/cleared. Leaves them staged and balance-neutral; preserves financial/source identity.

account.description: Account alias, ID or name

tools.name: setup-status
tools.description: Show missing or incomplete setup that affects CLI and automation workflows.

tools.name: split-placeholder-transaction
tools.description: Resolve an unresolved placeholder into multiple concrete transactions whose amounts exactly equal the original placeholder amount.

tools.name: split-transaction
tools.description: Audited split correction across multiple categories. Amounts remain in the main currency unit. Finalized ordinary rows are supported; protected provenance and dependent evidence require their dedicated workflows.

transactionId.description: The ID of the transaction to split

categoryId.description: Category ID for this split portion

amount.description: Amount for this split in main currency unit

splits.description: Array of split portions. Must have at least 2 splits.

tools.name: suggest-category
tools.description: Suggest a category for a transaction description using the existing auto-categorization rules, optionally enqueueing the suggestion for review.

description.description: Transaction description or merchant text to categorize

enqueue.description: Store the suggestion in the review queue

transactionId.description: Optional transaction ID for queued review

categoryId.description: Optional category ID to enqueue instead of the rule suggestion

dryRun.description: Validate and preview queue writes

tools.name: supersede-reconciliation-bridge
tools.description: Preview a protected bridge replacement; apply requires its exact reviewed token. Preserves original evidence, every later anchor and current stored/effective balances.

account.description: Account alias, ID or name

coverageIds.description: Independent coverage IDs from set-source-coverage. Provisional coverage also requires acknowledgeProvisional and provisionalProvenance.

tools.name: tag-transaction
tools.description: Add a tag to an existing transaction using the transaction tags JSON field.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Preview or apply rollback for supported transaction or credit-card-statement create/update/delete audit entries. Metadata corrections and batch receipts require a new reviewed correction. Preview is the default; pass apply=true to write.

last.description: Select the latest matching undoable audit entry

since.description: Only consider audit entries at or after this ISO timestamp

command.description: Optional audit action filter. Currently maps to audit_log.action.

account.description: Filter transaction/statement audit snapshots by account

transactionId.description: Undo the latest audit entry for this transaction

statementId.description: Undo the latest audit entry for this credit-card statement

dryRun.description: Force preview mode. Preview mode is also used whenever apply is false.

apply.description: Actually apply the undo. Without apply, the tool only previews.

allowDependentWrites.description: Allow undo even when later audit writes exist for the same entity

note.description: Optional audit note for the undo operation

tools.name: unlink-card-statement-payment
tools.description: Void a statement payment allocation while retaining immutable historical IDs. Does not delete or change its transaction or account balances.

tools.name: unmatch-receivable
tools.description: Preview or reverse a receivable payment link, preserving bank transactions and receipt history. Select paymentId or all=true when several payments exist.

paymentId.description: One receipt link to reverse; omit for a sole active payment

all.description: Explicitly reverse all active payment links

apply.description: Apply the reversal; defaults to preview

expectedToken.description: Token from the reviewed reversal preview; rejects changed receipts

tools.name: unmatch-transfer-transactions
tools.description: Preview or atomically reverse a matched transfer, restoring the source expense and archived income mirror without deleting statement provenance.

apply.description: Apply the unmatch; defaults to preview

tools.name: untag-transaction
tools.description: Remove a tag from an existing transaction.

tag.description: Tag label or key to remove

tools.name: update-account
tools.description: Update an existing account. Use this to change the name, type, currency, balance, credit limit, or billing dates of an account.

accountId.description: The ID of the account to update

balance.description: New balance in main currency unit

valuationMode.description: Explicit balance ownership; required for new investment/crypto accounts

observedDate.description: Balance observation end-of-day date; later activity is retained

anyOf.description: New credit limit in main currency unit

creditLimit.description: New credit limit in main currency unit

dryRun.description: Validate and preview the account update without writing it

tools.name: update-bucket
tools.description: Update cashflow bucket name, description, target, sort order, or active flag. IDs and allocation history are preserved. Use clearFields to null description or targetAmount.

clearFields.description: Nullable fields to clear: description, targetAmount

dryRun.description: Validate and preview without writing

tools.name: update-credit-card-statement
tools.description: Update a persisted credit-card statement, including paid amount and payment status.

statementId.description: Credit card statement ID to update

accountId.description: Move statement to this credit card account ID

account.description: Move statement to this credit card account alias, ID, or exact name

statementBalance.description: New statement balance in the main currency unit

minimumPayment.description: New minimum payment in the main currency unit

paidAmount.description: New paid amount in the main currency unit

status.description: New payment status. Defaults from updated amounts and due date when amount/date fields change.

dryRun.description: Validate and preview without writing

tools.name: update-goal
tools.description: Update a savings goal. Can add/withdraw saved amounts, change the target, deadline, or other details. Null or clear flags remove optional deadline, notes, and account; omission preserves them.

goalId.description: The ID of the goal to update

targetAmount.description: New target amount in the goal’s recorded currency

addAmount.description: Amount to add in the goal’s recorded currency; linked account money is unchanged

withdrawAmount.description: Amount to withdraw in the goal’s recorded currency; linked account money is unchanged

notes.description: New notes. Pass null or clearNotes to clear; omit to preserve.

accountId.description: Account ID to link this goal to. Pass null or clearAccount to unlink.

tools.name: update-subscription
tools.description: Update a subscription by ID with optional account/category resolution and a dry-run preview.

amount.description: New subscription amount in the main currency unit

nextBillingDate.description: New next billing date in YYYY-MM-DD format

account.description: New linked account alias, exact account ID, or exact account name

icon.description: New icon. Pass null, an empty string, or clearIcon to clear.

color.description: New color. Pass null, an empty string, or clearColor to clear.

url.description: New URL. Pass null, an empty string, or clearUrl to clear.

notes.description: New notes. Pass null, an empty string, or clearNotes to clear.

dryRun.description: Validate and preview the subscription update without writing it

tools.name: update-transaction
tools.description: Update an existing transaction. Use this when the user wants to change the amount, description, category, date, or other details of a transaction.

transactionId.description: The ID of the transaction to update

amount.description: Re-entered original amount in inputCurrency units

inputCurrency.description: Re-entered original currency for an FX financial replacement.

fxAcceptanceGuard.description: Exact guard returned by the current FX update dry run.

category.description: New category name — will match the closest existing category

notes.description: New notes. Pass an empty string to clear.

note.description: New workflow changelog note. Pass an empty string to clear.

source.description: New automation source or origin label. Pass an empty string to clear.

status.description: New transaction status. Pending transactions do not affect account balances.

ledgerTreatment.description: New ledger treatment. Use finalize-staged-statement-history to make staged rows effective.

stagingBatchId.description: New staging batch ID. Pass an empty string to clear when the row is not staged.

recurringRuleId.description: New linked recurring rule ID. Pass an empty string to clear.

accountId.description: New account ID to move the transaction to

transferToAccountId.description: Destination account ID for transfer transactions

dryRun.description: Validate and preview the update without writing it

tools.name: upsert-account
tools.description: Idempotently create or update an account by accountId, account name, or account alias. Returns whether the account was created or updated.

accountId.description: Stable account ID to update or create

account.description: Account alias, exact account ID, exact account name, or new account name

alias.description: Friendly alias to match or assign, e.g. bbva-checking

name.description: Account name to create or set

type.description: Account type to create or set

currency.description: Currency or asset code to create or set

balance.description: Account balance in the main currency unit

valuationMode.description: Explicit balance ownership; required for new investment/crypto accounts

observedDate.description: Balance observation end-of-day date; later activity is retained

anyOf.description: Credit limit in the main currency unit (only for credit_card type)

creditLimit.description: Credit limit in the main currency unit (only for credit_card type)

statementClosingDay.description: Day of the month the statement closes (1-31, only for credit_card type)

paymentDueDay.description: Day of the month payment is due (1-31, only for credit_card type)

dryRun.description: Validate and preview the account upsert without writing it

tools.name: upsert-budget
tools.description: Idempotently create or update a scoped budget.

scope.description: Exact source-account, allocation-category and recognition-tag scope

currency.description: Stored plan currency; changing it requires amount

tools.name: write-notebook
tools.description: Write or update a markdown note in the notebook. Use for research findings, portfolio reviews, market signals, and educational content.

append.description: If true, append to existing note instead of overwriting
